text:
incident-bot: 🔔 Incident created — cross-region routing anomaly detected. Automatic alert: large fraction of requests originating in eu-west2 are being routed to us-west2 for the inference-prod service. Metric: latency p50 -> p95 widening, some 5xx uptick. Severity: high.

Alex K: oncall here, looking. Which customer buckets are hitting this? any 5xx spike?

Maya R: seeing route tags flip in the geo-steering control plane. Policies still show eu preference but traffic counters show >60% egress to us-west2 since ~14:07 UTC. No bulk 500s yet, small 502 spike for specific VIPs.

Sam P: I can push an emergency pin for eu-west2 to cut the misroute while we investigate steering decisions. Want me to apply now?

Alex K: yes. do the pin but keep TTL short (60s) so we can revert. document the command.

Sam P: running mitigation now — applying pin rule to routing-policy:inference-prod:eu-west2 -> forced preference with ttl=60s.

opsbot: Deploy command accepted. Running change: set-route --policy inference-prod --region eu-west2 --action pin --ttl 60 --by sam.p

opsbot: Change applied to edge controllers in eu-west2 (4/4) — propagation started.

incident-bot: Status update: after pin applied at 14:12 UTC, traffic steer shows eu-west2 origin -> eu-west2 target increased from 38% -> 92% within 20s. Latency p95 dropped back to baseline for eu clients.

Jin L: taking on-call handoff from Alex. Monitoring logs for any downstream cache/KV thrash.

Eva S: contacting Customer Success to notify top impacted accounts (IDs: C-1334, C-2212, C-998). Prepared message template.

Alex K: quick impact summary for postmortem notes: window of misrouting ~14:07–14:12 (5m). Root cause prelim: policy state drift between control-plane config and edge controller after recent steering-rollout. No broad 5xx outage; observed 502s ~0.3% at peak for 3 VIPs. Some customers saw latency increases ~400–800ms on inference calls.

Maya R: logs show a config reconciliation delay — the steering service returned older policy snapshot for eu region due to a race with a canary push. Canary pushed at 14:05, reconciliation backfill failed for ~2 minutes. Edge controllers accepted stale policy and favored us-west2.

Sam P: filing emergency rollback for the canary in steering service. Rolling back canary now to restore normal reconciliation behavior.

opsbot: Rollback initiated: steward/steering-service canary -> previous stable at 14:14 UTC.

incident-bot: Update: rollback completed at 14:16 UTC. Reconciliation background job re-applied correct snapshot by 14:18 UTC. Metrics: route allocations normalized by 14:19 UTC.

Jin L: monitoring for thrash — will keep pin in place until next stable reconciliation confirmed for 5m windows.

Alex K: customer impact assessment: affected: 3 VIPs across 2 regions, ~12% of global request rate to inference-prod during window diverted cross-region; estimated excess egress cost ~ $160 for the window; number of distinct customers showing degraded latency: 8 (3 high-priority). No data-plane errors beyond transient 502s; no evidence of dropped requests or model failures.

Eva S: I sent the CS notes to account managers and included mitigation timeline + suggested outreach.

Henry T: assign to me for postmortem. Please capture: steering canary deployment flow, reconciliation path, edge controller policy refresh logic, and alerting gaps (we didn't have a policy-state drift alert).

Maya R: adding immediate follow-ups: (1) add a policy-state hash check between control-plane and edge to detect drift, (2) enforce atomic rollback path for steering canaries, (3) extend reconciliation retries and increase logging for snapshots.

Sam P: I'll open a quick runbook entry for emergency pin + short-ttl pattern so SREs have orthogonal mitigation.

Jin L: leaving pin in place til 14:25 UTC per discussion, then will slowly relax TTL to 300s and remove if stable.

opsbot: Policy pin removed from edge controllers (eu-west2) at 14:25 UTC — gradual removal acknowledged.

incident-bot: Incident resolved and archived at 14:28 UTC. Summary: routing policy state drift caused cross-region misroutes; temporary pin and steering canary rollback mitigated impact. Postmortem owner: Henry T. Follow-ups assigned to Maya R, Sam P.

Alex K: thanks everyone. main action: add drift detection + tighten canary rollback. I'll schedule a quick tech review with Maya and Henry in next 48h. :thumbsup:

Eva S: sending customer follow-up notes now.

Henry T: I'll take the RCA writeup. assigning timeline tasks in GH.

incident-bot: This incident generated an on-call page at 14:08 UTC (pagerduty incident PD-892113). Acknowledged by Alex K at 14:09 UTC.

Alex K: closing my on-call now, leaving summary in ops doc.

Sam P: logging commands used during mitigation for runbook: ```
# emergency pin
set-route --policy inference-prod --region eu-west2 --action pin --ttl 60 --comment "emergency-mitigate-1965432109"
# rollback canary
kubectl -n steward rollout undo deploy/steering-service --to-revision=stable
```

Jin L: monitoring closed, marking incident as mitigated.

opsbot: Note: automated billing estimate job recorded incremental egress cost tag for incident id 1965432109.

incident-bot: If you were paged, please complete oncall-handoff checklist and mark mitigated in PD.
